Explanation:  
The Ground Truth Answer states that the schools were segregated until 1955, and that Miller Williams began his master's in 1952. The Predicted Answer states that when Williams began his master's around 1951–52, the schools in Hoxie, Arkansas, were still racially segregated and did not integrate until 1955. The vital facts—that the schools were segregated at the time Williams began his master's, and that integration happened in 1955—are clearly present in the Predicted Answer. The Predicted Answer also mentions the same time frame and context, thus fully captures the substance of the Ground Truth.
